Cloud apps / C3-Bot

C3-Bot

Inboxes app of the Cloud fleet.

Intro

A Telegram bot for the C3 infrastructure: alerts, questions and answers between the cloud and its operator. It is a bot, not an AI assistant, and has no APK of its own; the SuperApp tile opens Telegram.

UI Preview

Screenshot of C3-Bot coming soon

MCP & API Docs

The bot is the delivery channel for the cloud's operator notifications and ask-and-wait prompts. There is no public API.

Download

This one lives in Telegram and has no APK. Install the SuperApp to reach it from the Cloud page.
